One common native density per source preserves real bends and kneels; the whole cell scales around baseline244 without body edits.

Measure only the visible HUMAN pilot crown-to-foot-pedal body axis, excluding outer claws/cage. This visually selected approximate upright/braced pilot bridge calibrates the human pilot to the project190 target while uniformly scaling the ENTIRE original loader cell. It is not an official anatomical measurement; four native loader/pilot posture ratios remain intact.
